title: NASA-UAP-D030, STS-80 Unidentified Object Image 1, 1996
what_is_it: A photograph taken from a NASA Space Shuttle mission (STS-80) showing an unidentified object in low-Earth orbit.

'Unidentified object' describes the appearance in the photograph only; it does not imply a non-terrestrial or anomalous origin. Objects near the Shuttle in orbit are commonly ice crystals, debris, or reflections.
